 This application coming on for admission this day, the 
 following:
 Order

By this petition preferred under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C., the petitioner has challenged the proceedings of the trial pending before the Special Judge (Indore Municipal Corporation, Indore)
vide RCT No.2627902/2009 for offences punishable under Sections 2(ia) (c) (d) (m),
2(ix)(a)(c)(e)(g)(k), 7(i)(ii)
(v) and 16(i)a(i)(ii) Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.
02.
From the record, it is apparent that the complaint was filed in the year 2009 and the petitioner was arrayed as an accused therein than itself.
Specific allegations were made against him at page No.3 of the complaint and the reasons were also mentioned therein as to why he has been made an accused.

The proceedings before the Court remained pending for 12 years and thereafter the statement on behalf of the respondent through its Officer was recorded on 15.01.2021 in which also allegation has Arvind vs Indore Municipal Corporation on 10 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/118104885/
1 been levelled against the petitioner.
This petition for quashment of the proceedings has been filed three years after recording of such statement.

03. The contention of the learned counsel for the petitioner as to whether the petitioner is involved in the case and whether there is any material to proceed with against him are not liable to be considered in this petition under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. particularly when the proceedings were instituted in 2009 and have already commenced.
Nothing has been brought on record to show the present status of the proceedings.
All the contentions as have been raised by the petitioner in this petition would certainly be available to him before the Court below itself at the appropriate stage of the proceedings.
04. Thus in view of the aforesaid, I am not inclined to interfere in the proceedings of the Court below at this belated stage.
The petition being devoid of merits is hereby dismissed.

(PRANAY VERMA) JUDGE Shilpa Arvind vs Indore Municipal Corporation on 10 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/118104885/
